subject: Physical and Health Education
examFormat: The aim of the UTME Physical and Health Education syllabus is to prepare candidates for the Board's examination. The course objectives are to: acquire basic knowledge and practical skills in motor activities, fitness, body maintenance and self-awareness; acquire basic knowledge required to practise positive health habits and maintenance of health; understand the relationship between human movement and biological, physical and social sciences; appreciate the ecological relationship between man and his environment with a view to preventing the spread of diseases; and stimulate and sustain their interest in Physical and Health Education. The syllabus is arranged in sections A to L.
recommendedTexts: An Introductory Textbook of Physical Education for Secondary Schools and Colleges, Vol. 1 — Afuekwe, A.I. (Sales Point (Nig.) Co., 2007)
Health Topics in the New Curriculum of Physical and Health Education, Vol. 1 — Afuekwe, A.I. (Seas Print (Nig.) Co., 2009)
Foundation of Health and Physical Education for Schools, Vol. II — Nnabueze, U.C. (Okotech Publishers, Enugu, 2002)
Comprehensive Textbook on Physical and Health Education — Ofadeji, A.A. (2013)
Fundamentals of Physical Education — Oworu, O.O. (Lucky Odoni (Nig.) Enterprises, 2004)

A Textbook of Physical and Health Education for Secondary School in Contemporary Nigeria Education System — Oyerinde, O.O., Dada, J.O. and Oloyede, R.O. (Fabonish Publisher, Positive Press, Ibadan, 2021, 4th Edition)
All Times Health Education for Individual and College Student — Oyerinde, O.O., Dada, J.O. and Oloyede, R.O. (Fabonish Publisher, Bayero University Press, 2021, 4th Edition)
Foundations of Physical Education and Sports — Puffa, H.A., Agbeko, W.W. and Amui, J.C. (Akwu, Winneba, Ghana, 2009)

topics.name: Principles, Meaning, Scope and Philosophy of Physical Education
objectives: state the meaning, nature, objectives and scope of PE
narrate the philosophy of the Founding Fathers
trace the historical development of PE in ancient Greece, Rome and Nigeria
trace the origin and development of the ancient Greek festivals (Isthmian, Pythian, Nemean and the Olympian)
topics.content: Definition, nature, scope and objectives of Physical Education (PE). Philosophy of the founding fathers of PE (Hetherington, Dudley Sergent, Thomas Wood, John Dewey). History and development of PE in ancient Greece (Sparta, Athens) and Rome, and in pre-colonial, colonial and post-colonial eras in Nigeria.

topics.name: Philosophy, Objectives and Settings of Health Education
objectives: define health education
state the philosophy and objectives of health education
differentiate between the meanings of health promotion and health education
topics.content: Meaning, philosophy and objectives of Health Education. Settings of Health Education: home-based, school-based, community based, health facility-based, workplace-based. Meaning of Health Promotion.

topics.name: Cells, Tissues and Systems of the Human Body
objectives: identify cell structures and their functions
identify types of cell, tissue, organ and system in human
differentiate between mitosis and meiosis
explain cell differentiation
list organs and systems in human body
topics.content: Structure and functions of a typical human cell. Types of cell and tissue: epithelial, connective, muscle and nerve. Cell division and differentiation: mitosis, meiosis. Organs and systems of the human body.

topics.name: Skeletal System
objectives: identify the structure of the human skeleton and their functions
identify types of bone that make up the human skeleton
differentiate types of joint using appropriate examples
identify the different kinds of movement permitted at joints
topics.content: Axial and appendicular skeletons and their functions. Bones and joints involved in movement: structure and types of bone; structure and types of joint; movements at the joints.

topics.name: Muscular System
objectives: identify by name and location the major muscles in human
state the functions of major muscles in human
differentiate between isometric and isotonic contractions
topics.content: Major muscles of the body and their functions. Isometric and isotonic contractions.

topics.name: Nervous System and Sense Organs
objectives: identify the structures of the central nervous system
explain the functions of the central nervous system in the body
state the types of nerve
describe reflex action with specific examples
describe the structure of the sense organs and their functions
topics.content: Structures and functions of the central nervous system (brain and spinal cord). Types of nerve: voluntary, involuntary (simple reflex action). Structure and functions of the sense organs: skin (tactile/touch), nose (olfactory/smell), tongue (taste), ear (auditory/hearing), eye (sight).

topics.name: Circulatory System
objectives: draw and label the heart
compare the specific functions of the arteries, veins and capillaries
identify the components of blood
state the functions of blood
describe the systemic and pulmonary circulations
topics.content: Structure and functions of the heart and vessels. Composition and functions of blood. Types of blood circulation (systemic and pulmonary).

topics.name: Respiratory System
objectives: describe the structure of the respiratory organs and state their functions
explain the processes of inspiration and expiration
explain cellular and tissue respiration
topics.content: Structure and functions of the respiratory organs: nose, trachea and lungs. Process of respiration: inspiration and expiration. Tissue and cellular respiration.

topics.name: Excretory System
objectives: identify the structure of the kidney and skin
state the functions of the kidney, skin and excretory functions of lungs
explain the processes of formation of urine, sweat and carbon dioxide
topics.content: Structure and functions of the kidney, skin and excretory functions of lungs. Formation of excretory products: urine, sweat and carbon dioxide.

topics.name: Somatotypes and Posture
objectives: describe the various body types
relate body types to performance of physical activities
define and state the characteristics of good posture
explain the types of postural defects
state the causes of postural defects, for example: poor habits, accident, heredity and disease
explain the role of exercise, nutrition, good habits and medical intervention in the correction of postural defects
topics.content: Description of endomorph, mesomorph and ectomorph. Relationship between body types and physical activities. Definition and characteristics of correct posture. Types of postural defect: flatfoot, scoliosis, kyphosis, lordosis. Causes and corrective measures of postural defects.

topics.name: Athletics: Track Events
objectives: name the events that make up the short distance/sprint races
identify starting styles in sprint races
differentiate the visual and non-visual types of baton take-over
explain the relay take-over zone
explain the different distances and clearance in hurdling
describe the start, stride and finish in middle and long distance races
name the events which make up the middle distance and long distance races
differentiate the rules, regulations and officiating as applicable to each track event
topics.content: Short distance races/sprints: 50m, 100m, 200m, 400m, hurdles and relay races. Sprint start styles: bullet/bunch, medium and elongated. Visual and non-visual baton take-over and take-over zone in relay. Flight over hurdles and distancing in high and low hurdle events. The start, stride and finish in middle distance races (800m and 1,500m). The start, stride and finish in long distance races (3,000m, 5,000m, 10,000m, marathon and cross-country). Rules, regulations and officiating.

topics.name: Athletics: Field Events
objectives: name the events which make up throwing and jumping events
identify various facilities, equipment and specifications
explain the styles and techniques in throwing and jumping events
explain the rules and regulations in throwing and jumping events
discuss safety precautions in throwing events
topics.content: Throwing events (discus, javelin and shot put): facilities and equipment with specification; styles and techniques; rules, regulations and officiating; safety measures. Jumping events (high jump, long jump, pole vault and triple jump): facilities and equipment with specification; style and techniques; rules, regulations and officiating.

topics.name: Ball Games: Football and Basketball
objectives: describe the skills in football and basketball
identify various facilities and equipment in football and basketball
identify the officials of the games of football and basketball and their functions
differentiate the rules and regulations of football and basketball
topics.content: Skills in football and basketball. Facilities and equipment in football and basketball. Rules, regulations and officiating in football and basketball.

topics.name: Racket Games: Table Tennis and Badminton
objectives: describe the skills in table tennis and badminton
identify various facilities and equipment in table tennis and badminton
identify the officials in table tennis and badminton and state their functions
differentiate the rules and regulations of table tennis and badminton
topics.content: Skills in table tennis and badminton. Specification of facilities and equipment in table tennis and badminton. Rules, regulations and officiating in table tennis and badminton.

topics.name: Food
objectives: indicate the sources and importance of the various classes of food nutrients
define balanced diet and state its importance
draw up and specify dietary requirements for different groups of people
explain methods for food preparation, preservation and storage
explain the principles of food hygiene
topics.content: Classes, sources and importance of food nutrients. Definition and composition of balanced diet. Diet planning for different groups of people: children, adolescents, athletes, pregnant women and the aged. Food preparation, preservation, hygiene and storage.

topics.name: Nutrition
objectives: define nutrition and state the nutritional values of beverages
state the common nutritional deficiencies and their remedies
highlight the importance of water in human nutrition
topics.content: Definition and nutritional values of beverages. Common nutritional deficiencies and their remedies. Importance of water in human nutrition.

topics.name: Drugs
objectives: define drug and state the types
differentiate between drug misuse and abuse
state causes and prevention of drug misuse and abuse
explain the effects of drug misuse, abuse and self-medication on the body
topics.content: Meaning and types: stimulants, narcotics, hallucinogens, sedatives and ergogenic aids. Use, misuse and abuse. Causes and prevention of drug misuse and abuse. Effects of drug misuse, abuse and self-medication on the body.

topics.name: Physical Fitness
objectives: define physical fitness
outline and explain components of physical fitness
give examples of health-related and performance/skill-related components
state the benefits of physical activity and exercise
topics.content: Definition of physical fitness. Components of physical fitness: health-related and performance/skill-related. Benefits of physical activity and exercise.

topics.name: Conditioning Programme
objectives: differentiate between aerobic and anaerobic programmes
differentiate between strength and endurance training programmes
topics.content: Aerobic programme. Anaerobic programme. Strength training programme. Endurance training programme.

topics.name: Recreation and Leisure
objectives: differentiate among recreation, leisure, work and rest
state the importance of recreation, leisure, work and rest
mention types of recreation and give examples of each
differentiate between recreational activities and competitive sports
state safety measures in recreation
topics.content: Definition and importance of recreation, leisure, work and rest. Types of recreational activities: outdoor (jogging, swimming, cycling, watching birds, hiking, camping, picnicking) and indoor (viewing TV, video games, computer games, playing musical instruments, billiards, card games, Ayo, draught). Differences between recreational activities and competitive sports.

topics.name: Dance
objectives: define dance and state its importance
identify traditional dances from various parts of Nigeria
describe the dance steps for various traditional dances in Nigeria
identify the costumes for the various traditional dances
topics.content: Definition and importance of dance. Traditional dances and dance steps from various parts of Nigeria. Costumes for the various traditional dances in Nigeria.

topics.name: First Aid
objectives: define first aid
state the aims and principles of first aid
outline the qualities of a first aider
list the contents of the first aid box and their uses
identify types of common injury
identify types of common condition that require first aid
identify agencies involved in first aid services
topics.content: Definition of first aid. Aims and principles of first aid. Qualities of a first aider. First aid box and contents. Common injuries that require first aid: cuts, wound, sprain, strain, dislocation, fracture. Special conditions that require first aid: bleeding, burn, scald, shock, poisoning. Agencies/bodies involved in first aid: St. John's Ambulance, Red Cross Society.

topics.name: Safety Education
objectives: define accident and disaster
identify types of accident and disaster
state the causes and prevention of accident and disaster
identify various disaster relief activities
explain safety measures at home, workplace, school and community
topics.content: Meaning and types of accident and disaster. Causes and prevention of accident and disaster. Disaster relief activities. Safety at home, workplace, school and community.

topics.name: Sports Competitions at National Level
objectives: identify by name sports competitions organized by sports federations/associations and corporate organizations
state the importance of the National Sports Festival
highlight the organizational and administrative structures of sports competitions in Nigeria
topics.content: Types of competition: national sports competitions organized by different sports federations/associations; national sports competitions organized by corporate organizations; importance of the National Sports Festival. Organisation and administration of sports competitions.

topics.name: Names and Roles of Institutional Games
objectives: state the names and roles of the different institutional games
topics.content: The University Games (NUGA). The Polytechnic Games (NIPOGA). The Colleges of Education Games (NATCEGA). National School Sports Games (NSSF).

topics.name: International Sports Competitions and Governing Bodies
objectives: narrate the history and evolution of the All Africa Games
identify the aims of the All Africa Games
identify by name international sports governing bodies
describe the administrative structure of international governing bodies
topics.content: All Africa Games: history and evolution; aims. International sports governing bodies: names and administrative structure of SCSA, IOC, FIFA, IAAF, ISSF, FIBA, ITTF, BWF.

topics.name: Meaning and Types of Disability and Special Needs
objectives: define disability and describe people with special needs
identify types of disability and special need

topics.name: Adapted Physical Activities for People with Disabilities and Special Needs
objectives: identify physical activities for people with disabilities and special needs

topics.name: Social and Emotional Problems of People with Special Needs
objectives: state the social and emotional problems of people with disabilities

topics.name: Prevention of Disability
objectives: state preventive measures of disability

topics.name: Corrective Exercises to Rehabilitate People with Special Needs
objectives: state corrective exercise to rehabilitate people with special needs

topics.name: Personal Health
objectives: define personal health and state its importance
differentiate the care of various parts of the body
state the methods of promoting and maintaining personal health
state the outcome of personal health screening for the eye, ear and dental
topics.content: Meaning and importance of personal health. Personal hygiene: care of various body parts (teeth, mouth, hair, skin, hands and nails). Methods of promotion and maintenance of personal health: exercise, nutrition, regular medical check-up. Personal health screening: eye defects and their corrections (myopia, hypermetropia, astigmatism); auditory defects and their corrections (otitis media, partial deafness); dental diseases (dental caries, gingivitis).

topics.name: Community Health
objectives: differentiate between orthodox and traditional health services
differentiate among various aspects of maternal and child health services
identify the characteristics of elderly persons and state the ways of relating with them
identify common causes of death
topics.content: Community health services: providers of health services (orthodox services; traditional services - bone setters, birth attendants). Various aspects of family health: maternal and child health (ante-natal care, immunization, oral rehydration therapy, breast feeding and safe motherhood). Aging and death education: characteristics of elderly persons; ways of relating with the elderly; common causes of death.

topics.name: Disease: Meaning and Causes
objectives: define disease and state the causes

topics.name: Communicable Diseases
objectives: define communicable disease and state its classification with examples
highlight the prevention and control measures of communicable diseases
topics.content: Definition. Classification of communicable diseases: air-borne/respiratory diseases (measles, whooping cough, poliomyelitis, tuberculosis and cerebro-spinal meningitis); water/food-borne diseases (dysentery, cholera, typhoid fever); insect-borne diseases (malaria, yellow fever, trypanosomiasis); worm infections (Ascaris lumbricoides, Ancylostoma duodenale (hookworm), Dracunculus medinensis (guinea worm)); animal-borne diseases (rabies, leptospirosis); contact diseases (gonorrhoea, syphilis, Taenia capitis (ringworm), leprosy, Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome (AIDS)). Prevention and control measures: immunization, sterilization, isolation.

topics.name: Environmental Health
objectives: state the characteristics of good housing
state the town planning regulations
state the importance of water supply and list the sources
explain methods of water purification
differentiate between refuse and sewage disposal methods
define pollution and state its types
outline the prevention and control measures of pollution
differentiate between pest and vector and state their habits
explain the harmful effects of pest and vectors and highlight their prevention and control measures
topics.content: Housing: characteristics of good housing (location, ventilation, lighting and sanitation); town planning regulations (spacing, overcrowding). Water supply: importance and sources; methods of purification. Waste disposal: types (refuse, sewage); methods. Pollution: meaning and types (air, water, soil and noise); prevention and control. Pest and vector control: differences between pest and vector and their habits; harmful effects of pest and vector; prevention and control.

topics.name: Non-communicable Diseases
objectives: define non-communicable diseases with examples
highlight the prevention and control measures of non-communicable diseases
topics.content: Definition. Diseases: hypertension, sickle cell, cancer, epilepsy, ulcer, asthma, diabetes.

topics.name: Family
objectives: define the family and explain its types
state the characteristics of a happy family
topics.content: Definition and types: nuclear family (monogamous, polygamous, single parent family, family by adoption) and extended family. Characteristics of a happy family.

topics.name: Human Sexuality Education
objectives: explain human sexuality and state its importance
highlight the reproductive health rights
topics.content: Meaning and importance. Reproductive health rights: rights to number of children, consent to marry, gender equality and privacy.

topics.name: Family Planning
objectives: define family planning and state its importance
identify the various methods of family planning and state their advantages
state the challenges facing family life
identify agencies promoting healthy family living
topics.content: Definition and importance. Advantages and disadvantages of various methods of family planning: condom, pills, uterine device, abstinence. Challenges of families in Nigeria: pre-marital sex, extra-marital sex, widowhood. Agencies promoting healthy family living: school, NGO, religious homes.
